pages.name: understand
pages.title: Your first answer is a draft

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l07.intro
elements.html:
Revise unsupported wording and track what changed.

Treat a draft as material to inspect. Separate factual accuracy, clarity, and tone; a change can improve one while harming another. Keep the original, mark the revision, and explain why it is better. Disagree with a suggestion when the evidence supports you. A second AI opinion can be a useful challenge but is not an independent source by itself.

Practice scenario

Fictional survey: 12 of 20 club members liked a proposed time. Draft: “Everyone agrees this is the perfect time.”

choices.text: Nearly everyone agrees, so no discussion is needed.
12 of 20 respondents liked this time; ask about barriers before deciding.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l07.revise.feedback.all
elements.html: Eight of twenty did not agree; the conclusion goes beyond the data.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l07.revise.feedback.precise
elements.html: This reports the count and leaves room for disagreement.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l07.audit
elements.title: What belongs in a revision note?

choices.text: Changed “everyone” to 12 of 20 because the original overstated the survey.
Delete all record of the original.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l07.audit.feedback.reason
elements.html: This ties the edit to evidence.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l07.audit.feedback.pretty
elements.html: Style alone does not justify the factual correction.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l07.audit.feedback.erase
elements.html: Keeping a comparison makes reasoning reviewable.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l07.transfer
elements.title: Write an alternative honest summary. Explain a remaining limitation of this small survey.
elements.description: Practice text only. Saved on this device. Reviewed by you or an educator, not AI graded.

validators.text: Add enough reasoning to review (at least 30 characters).

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l07.rubric
elements.html:
Self-check

  • Reports 12/20 accurately.
  • Avoids claiming universal agreement.
  • Notes a limitation such as nonresponse, group size, or unasked reasons.

The scenario is fictional; it does not estimate any real school’s preferences.
